plan.reason: With only 24/100 evaluations and 20 stagnant iterations, rely on the auto surrogate to pick RBF vs quadratic by held-out RMSE, and raise exploration to 0.45 so the novelty term pushes sampling away from an exhausted region. current_to_best balances convergence with diversity at this small budget; moderate mutation/crossover keep DE from collapsing prematurely. A smaller radius (0.15) and low local_fraction concentrate exploitation once the surrogate is trustworthy, while population 30 and generations 8 keep surrogate-assisted generations cheap relative to the remaining true-evaluation budget of 76.
